checkout.title: Pass checkout
checkout.desc: Review your plan order and pay securely with Toss Payments.
checkout.consentAgree: I have read and agree to the withdrawal/refund terms above. (Required)
checkout.preparingDesc: Payments are being prepared. Please try again shortly.
checkout.errNoPlan: No plan code. Please pick a plan again.
checkout.errPlanNotFound: Plan not found. Please pick a plan again.
checkout.payCancelled: Payment was cancelled or failed. Please try again.
checkout.cfRefundNote: Cancel or request a refund in your library.
checkout.refundL1: Full refund within 7 days of payment with no usage (withdrawal).
checkout.refundL2: Otherwise, immediate cancellation refunds the pro-rated remainder by days used. No penalty (mid-term).
checkout.refundL3: Standard cancellation ends service at expiry with no refund.
checkout.refundL4: Usage means 30+ seconds of playback or 1 download.
checkout.refundL5: Passes are 1-month short passes with no auto-renewal. Cancel or refund directly from My Pass.
checkout.refundL6: Refunds return in 3-5 business days depending on method.
checkout.refundSummary: Full refund if unused within 7 days; otherwise pro-rated refund on immediate cancellation (no penalty); standard cancellation runs to expiry.
